key: OFBIZ-13388
fields: {'summary': 'sendInvoicePerEmail fails with MissingMethodException: invalid makeValidContext() call in InvoiceServicesScript.groovy', 'issuetype': {'self': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/issuetype/1', 'id': '1', 'description': 'A problem which impairs or prevents the functions of the product.', 'iconUrl': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/secure/viewavatar?size=xsmall&avatarId=21133&avatarType=issuetype', 'name': 'Bug', 'subtask': False, 'avatarId': 21133}, 'description': '**Summary**
The `sendInvoicePerEmail` service in
`component://accounting/src/main/groovy/org/apache/ofbiz/accounting/invoice/InvoiceServicesScript.groovy`
fails at runtime with a MissingMethodException because
`DispatchContext.makeValidContext()` is invoked with a single Map argument,
but no such overload exists. Valid signatures are:
\xa0 - makeValidContext(String, String, Map)
\xa0 - makeValidContext(ModelService, String, Map)

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Trigger the `sendInvoicePerEmail` service (e.g. from the invoice screen's
\xa0 \xa0"Send per Email" action, which runs it async via the JobQueue).
2. Observe the async job failure in the OFBiz log.

**Expected behaviour**
The invoice email is scheduled and sent via `sendMailFromScreen`.

**Actual behaviour**
Async job fails with:
\xa0 groovy.lang.MissingMethodException: No signature of method:
\xa0 org.apache.ofbiz.service.DispatchContext.makeValidContext() is applicable
\xa0 for argument types: (LinkedHashMap)

**Proposed fix**
Use the 3-argument overload, passing the target service name and the IN mode:

\xa0 \xa0 Map emailParams = dispatcher.getDispatchContext()
\xa0 \xa0 \xa0 \xa0 \xa0 \xa0 .makeValidContext('sendMailFromScreen', 'IN', ctx)

Patch attached.

**Environment**
OFBiz <your version/branch>, Groovy 5.0.0-alpha-11, JDK 17', 'comment': {'comments': [], 'maxResults': 0, 'total': 0, 'startAt': 0}, 'priority': {'self': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/priority/2', 'iconUrl': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/images/icons/priorities/critical.svg', 'name': 'Critical', 'id': '2'}, 'status': {'self': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/status/1', 'description': 'The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.', 'iconUrl': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/images/icons/statuses/open.png', 'name': 'Open', 'id': '1', 'statusCategory': {'self': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/statuscategory/2', 'id': 2, 'key': 'new', 'colorName': 'blue-gray', 'name': 'To Do'}}}

key: OFBIZ-13386
fields: {'summary': 'order item attribute autoReserve not stored', 'issuetype': {'self': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/issuetype/1', 'id': '1', 'description': 'A problem which impairs or prevents the functions of the product.', 'iconUrl': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/secure/viewavatar?size=xsmall&avatarId=21133&avatarType=issuetype', 'name': 'Bug', 'subtask': False, 'avatarId': 21133}, 'description': "Creating an order, adding a product, checking 'Auto Reserve', no inventory reservation happens (service reserveStoreInventory is not called).

The problem results from a missing entry in the order_item_attribute table.

component://order/template/entry/cart/ShowCart.ftl\xa0

order_item_attr_autoReserve

attribute is not stored", 'comment': {'comments': [{'self': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/issue/13648227/comment/18075800', 'id': '18075800', 'author': {'self': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/user?username=golja', 'name': 'golja', 'key': 'golja', 'avatarUrls': {'48x48': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/secure/useravatar?avatarId=10452', '24x24': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/secure/useravatar?size=small&avatarId=10452', '16x16': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/secure/useravatar?size=xsmall&avatarId=10452', '32x32': 'https://issues.apache.org/jira/secure/useravatar?size=medium&avatarId=10452'}, 'displayName': 'Anahita Goljahani', 'active': True, 'timeZone': 'Etc/UTC'}, 'body': "Hi [~cahein], could you please clarify what kind of reservation you would like to make?

I’m asking because, if you simply want to reserve inventory items when sales orders are placed, you only need to set '{*}Allocate Resource{*}' to '{*}N{*}' in the store configuration (and therefore the 'Auto Reserve' checkbox will not be displayed on the screen where you add products to the order).

If, instead, you want to use the 'Inventory (Supply) Allocation Planning' feature, you need to set 'Allocate Resource' to 'Y'. If you want some insight into this feature, please refer to OFBIZ-10518. To be honest, the ticket description does not fully clarify all aspects of the allocation planning feature.
